prevention.name: Prevention
prevention.what: Control ignition sources and choose materials. That depends on knowing flammability limits.

detection.name: Detection
detection.what: Spot smoke and aerosols early. SAME and SAME-R tested detection in microgravity.

suppression.name: Suppression
suppression.what: Put the fire out. FLEX diluted the chamber atmosphere with CO₂ and helium, both of which suppress fire.

fundamentals.name: Modeling foundations
fundamentals.what: Flame physics and gaseous-fuel studies that feed predictive models of flammability.
